content.drawer_link_group_info: Leave at defaults for plain links, or style the links as a group.
content.drawer_top_row_info: Home, Search, and Account icons always show at the top of the drawer. Account shows when customer accounts are turned on.

settings.drawer_divider_width_info: Match header lines the divider and icons up with the header's edges.
settings.drawer_side_info: On phones the drawer fills the screen width. On larger screens it attaches to this side.
settings.drawer_header_buttons_info: Used when the menu drawer shows. The logo moves to the free side, or stays centered when the buttons are split.
